name: code-review
description: "Review a PR independently against the issue, architecture and current CI evidence."

# code review

Inspect the full current diff and related tests. Verify hardware sources, bus and timing behavior, failure cases, module boundaries and concurrency where relevant. Report severity, file/line, impact and suggested verification. Re-review the new commit after fixes and record unresolved blockers or readiness. Leave fixes to the implementer and merge to the owner.

Read [AGENTS.md](../../../AGENTS.md) for the workflow.
